infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Sigil uses Face ID to release the unwrap key that authorizes a secret. Denying never needs it.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sigil uses the camera once, to scan the pairing QR shown on your Mac.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Sigil connects to the relay running on your Mac over your local Wi-Fi to receive and answer approval requests.
